title: 新型磁体如何驱动未来能源革命
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: If you were to pick one thing to magically erase from existence, that would bring all of modern life to a screeching halt.
segments.zh: 如果选一样东西从世界上消失，现代生活将戛然而止。

segments.en: The best option would probably be magnets.
You are surrounded by magnets. Magnets are there in hard drives.
segments.zh: 你被磁铁包围着，硬盘里就有磁铁。

segments.en: I should prove the list. The list is amazing. I knew they exist.
segments.zh: 我应该列出清单，清单很惊人，我知道它们存在。

segments.en: I just, when I put it in a list, I was like, whoa.
segments.zh: 但当我列出来时，还是惊叹不已。

segments.en: Take apart your cell phone and you'll find a multitude of magnets inside.
segments.zh: 拆开手机，你会发现里面有很多磁铁。

segments.en: In the speaker and microphone, in the vibrating motor, stabilizing the camera lens, there are even tiny magnets on the circuit board.
segments.zh: 扬声器、麦克风、振动马达、相机镜头稳定器，甚至电路板上都有微小磁铁。

segments.en: It's no exaggeration to say, no magnets, no modern world.
segments.zh: 毫不夸张地说，没有磁铁就没有现代世界。

segments.en: And they're about to become even more important.
segments.zh: 而且它们将变得更加重要。

segments.en: As the world tries to become less dependent on fossil fuels, magnets and the multi-billion-dollar industry behind them are the key to many clean energy technologies,
segments.zh: 随着世界减少对化石燃料的依赖，磁铁及其数十亿美元的产业成为许多清洁能源技术的关键。

segments.en: including some crazy futuristic ones. This is the fundamental building block of our fusion technology.
segments.zh: 包括一些疯狂的未来设计。这是我们聚变技术的基础构件。

segments.en: But there's a big problem with our VIMs, very important magnets, that could derail the whole project of slowing climate change.
segments.zh: 但我们的VIM（非常重要的磁铁）有个大问题，可能阻碍整个减缓气候变化的项目。

segments.en: The supply chain of those is a challenge. About 90% of that material is processed in China.
segments.zh: 供应链是个挑战。约90%的材料在中国加工。

segments.en: And so the concern is that if there's no enough magnets to go around, there'll be restrictions to block.
segments.zh: 因此担忧是，如果磁铁不够用，可能会有限制措施。
